primitives.note: More Sparkles! arms Zoe's next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt (within 5s of any ability cast) to deal bonus magic damage as a non-projectile hit.
Paddle Star!'s initial cast and Sleepy Trouble Bubble both deal a fixed base+AP magic damage instance on hit, on cooldown.
Paddle Star! has an initial cast and a distinct recast (different speed/width, no cast time, resets its own distance-based damage modifier), each counting as a separate ability activation.
Paddle Star!'s total damage scales 0% to ~150% (bugged cap 146.6%) with distance travelled before impact, so damage depends on assumed cast/engage range.
Spell Thief spawns 3 bolts that seek and strike the nearest enemy over time, each dealing a separate magic damage instance, independent of Zoe's own attacks/casts.
Sleepy Trouble Bubble refunds a percentage of its own cooldown when it hits an enemy champion.
While asleep, the target takes 30% magic resistance reduction, increasing subsequent magic damage against it.

The next non-persistent damage instance against the sleeping target is upgraded with bonus true damage equal to that hit's post-mitigation damage, capped at the ability's own damage value; depends on the target's asleep (controlled) state.
Portal Jump resets Zoe's basic attack timer, even though it deals no damage itself.
Mana costs (40-60 for Q, flat 80 for E) can meaningfully cap how often these are cast inside a 15s window at low mana pools.

needsBespoke.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble's wake-up mechanic grants bonus true damage equal to the post-mitigation damage of the next qualifying hit on the sleeping target, capped at the ability's own base+AP value; this requires dynamically referencing another hit's own resulting damage and injecting a secondary true-damage instance conditioned on a consumable timed debuff, which no single closed-list primitive expresses cleanly (conditional-damage covers the 'target is controlled/asleep' gate but not 'damage equal to another hit's damage, capped'). Paddle Star!'s continuous 0-150%(bugged 146.6%) distance-based total-damage multiplier also needs bespoke numeric handling beyond a flag that positional assumptions apply.

proposal: Open with Sleepy Trouble Bubble (E) on the dummy: this deals its base+AP magic damage, applies drowsy/sleep, shreds 30% magic resist while asleep, and arms More Sparkles! for the next attack/bolt.

Immediately follow with a basic attack (or let a queued Spell Thief bolt fire) to consume the More Sparkles! empowered bonus and, if the target is already asleep, to trigger E's wake-up bonus true damage on that same hit.

Cast Paddle Star! (Q) at the assumed engage distance for its base+AP+distance-scaled damage, then use the recast during its 1s lingering window for a second, distance-reset damage instance if time and positioning allow.
Spam Spell Thief (W) on its 0.25s cooldown throughout the fight to continually re-arm More Sparkles! and keep 3 bolts firing at the dummy for extra magic damage instances.
Auto-attack in every gap between ability casts to maximize basic-attack (and onhit item) uptime.

Recast E and Q the moment each comes off cooldown (E's cooldown further shortened by its own on-hit refund), repeating the empower-then-attack sequencing each time to re-trigger More Sparkles! and, when a fresh sleep is active, the wake-up true damage bonus.
Omit Portal Jump (R) from the core loop since it deals no damage and imposes brief action lockouts, unless its attack-reset effect is confirmed to yield a net DPS gain given the fight length.
